news.analysis: Daniels and the Washington offense got off to a slow start on a rainy night at Northwest Stadium as they didn't score their first points until the second quarter. That being said, with the Commanders trailing 20-19, Daniels completed two long passes to Antonio Williams with less than a minute left in the game to set up a game-winning 26-yard field goal. Daniels has thrown for 10 touchdowns and two interceptions while adding 335 rushing yards and two scores on the ground in eight games this year. He will be a solid QB1 in fantasy in Week 12 vs. the Cardinals.
news.contents: Jayden Daniels completed 23 of his 35 passes for 289 yards and added six rushes for 55 yards in a 22-20 win over the Bengals in Week 11's Monday night game.

Okonkwo has caught 31 passes for 329 yards through eight games for the Commanders this season. He will be a TE2 in Week 12 vs. the Cardinals.
